{"sql": "WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020-%'
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
),
positive_count AS (
    SELECT 
        month_num,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month_num
),
avg_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        month_num,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month_num
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.month_num as month,
        pc.positive_count,
        ab.avg_balance
    FROM positive_count pc
    JOIN avg_balance ab ON pc.month_num = ab.month_num
),
highest_month AS (
    SELECT month_num, avg_balance
    FROM combined
    WHERE positive_count = (SELECT MAX(positive_count) FROM combined)
),
lowest_month AS (
    SELECT month_num, avg_balance

    WHERE positive_count = (SELECT MIN(positive_count) FROM combined)
)
SELECT 
    h.avg_balance,

        customer_id,

    FROM customer_transactions

    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
),
positive_count AS (

        month_num,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month_num
),
avg_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        month_num,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month_num
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.month_num as month,
        pc.positive_count,
        ab.avg_balance
    FROM positive_count pc
    JOIN avg_balance ab ON pc.month_num = ab.month_num
),
highest_month AS (
    SELECT month_num, avg_balance
    FROM combined
    WHERE positive_count = (SELECT MAX(positive_count) FROM combined)

lowest_month AS (
    SELECT month_num, avg_balance

    WHERE positive_count = (SELECT MIN(positive_count) FROM combined)
